positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Development of sign language classifier using hand kinematics data from 3D motion capture
•	Achieved dimension reduction of hand kinematics data using principle component analysis and canonical analysis using scikit-learn (machine learning library) in Python.
•	Compared the performance of tree-based and support vector machine-based hand shape classifier using scikit-learn in Python.
•	Achieved high accuracy real-time hand shape identification.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Data acquisition and analysis of epileptic seizure EEG data from human patients
•	Developed features for support vector machine (SVM)-based epileptic seizure detection/prediction algorithm using scikit-learn in Python.
•	Applied autoregressive model to the continuous EEG data for correlation analysis and signal prediction using scikit-learn in Python.
•	Developed an algorithm to identify the spatial location of epileptic seizures using granger causality measure in MATLAB.
•	Built an experimental setup to deliver auditory stimulus and record the EEG response from the subjects using National Instruments DAQ interfacing with LabVIEW.
•	Investigated mechanisms of seizure propagation based on analysis of EEG and single neuron behavior.
